All areas served

Your project, in Geneva and Veyrier.

Based in Gex, France, Création & Rénovation Gessienne also works in Switzerland, including Veyrier and the Geneva area. Enquiries cover our trades: masonry, plastering, partitions and tiling. The property address and working conditions are assessed before the scope of work is defined.

Describe my project in this area

Identify the property clearly.

Give the country, town, address and property type at the first contact. For a project in Veyrier, Troinex, Carouge or Thônex, include useful access details: floor level, lift, parking, passageways and any building access times. These help prepare the project assessment and the discussions needed to organise the work.

Define what changes and what stays.

If you want to rearrange a room, repair surfaces or replace tiles, describe how the space will be used and which existing elements should remain. Plans, approximate dimensions and wider photographs can support the conversation. The choice of work still depends on the condition of the surfaces and the constraints identified at the property.

Prepare a cross-border project.

For work in Switzerland, responsibilities, planned materials, access and working conditions need to be clear before work is agreed. We discuss these points based on your enquiry. The quotation and project-specific documents will set out the agreed scope.

Before you begin.

Can you assess a renovation project in Veyrier?

Yes, we assess enquiries in Veyrier, in the canton of Geneva, and the surrounding area. Describe the rooms, planned work and access to the property to prepare our conversation.

What information should I provide for work in Switzerland?

Include the country, town, property type, planned work and preferred timeframe. Add any available plans or dimensions and delivery constraints; we will clarify the working arrangements before agreeing the project.
